output.review_comment: The PR correctly implements the three documented rules plus adds necessary support for capitalizing small words after colons. The implementation properly handles: (1) preservation of mixed-case words like "iPhone" and "NASA", (2) small words rules with first/last/after-colon exceptions, and (3) standard capitalization for all other words. All 9 tests should pass, including the critical test_subtitle_after_colon which correctly capitalizes "From" (not in SMALL_WORDS) and "A" (small word after colon).
